assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production Unity UI nine-slice skin atlas, landscape 1536x1024, exactly THREE columns and TWO rows of equal square 512x512 cells on a genuinely transparent background. Each cell contains one square panel sample centered with 24 pixel transparent gutter to every cell edge. Reference image 1 is the LBC style guide only; reference image 2 supplies palette and painted fantasy material treatment only. Create SIX clean restrained painted mobile adventure UI skins, not a mockup. Top-left: aged ivory rice-paper travel backdrop with faint teal waterways/cloud line motifs ONLY along the outer edge and corners, a very quiet cream center. Top-middle: parchment window with softly grained ivory center, slender teal painted wooden frame with warm bronze bevel and tiny culturally neutral cloud/wave corner inlays. Top-right: deep jade/teal leather-and-painted-wood primary button sample, thin brass trim, restrained highlight and shadow, plain teal center. Bottom-left: cream paper secondary button sample, delicate warm brown/bronze edge and slight teal corner tabs, plain ivory center. Bottom-middle: dark teal velvet item slot with a neat thin antique brass lip and inset shadow, unadorned dark center. Bottom-right: thin elegant travel postcard frame in aged brass and teal with subtle small corner fittings, its central area completely transparent. All squares have the SAME outer bounds within their cell; keep decorative detail inside the outer 48-pixel border, straight mid-edge sections and plain center suitable for nine-slice stretching. Hand-painted 2D cartoon texture, clean warm brown outlines, low noise, subtle material detail, not ornate medieval stone. Palette cream #FFF3D9, teal #367F79, ink #224C65, gold #E7A53F, tiny terracotta #D15C3D accent. NO text, lettering, numbers, icons, characters, grids, labels, scene pictures, thick white outlines or checkerboard painting. Actual alpha around samples and in postcard center.
assets.cleanup_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit ONLY the background of this six-panel Unity texture atlas. Preserve all SIX panel designs, textures, edges, bevels, sizes and their EXACT POSITIONS on the same 1536x1024 canvas. Remove ALL of the brown gradient backdrop outside the panels and remove the brown backdrop visible in the hollow center of the bottom-right postcard frame. Those areas must become real transparent alpha. Preserve the four opaque panel centers and the opaque top-left parchment (five solid panels total). Do not repaint or redesign the panels. Do not add a checkerboard painting. Keep clean antialiased outlines with no brown halo. No text. Output a genuine transparent PNG atlas.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE square transparent Unity HUD icon. Style references only: supplied LBC art sheets. A charming small three-dimensional EARTH GLOBE: blue-teal round sphere with clearly recognizable green continents (Asia-facing), a thin warm antique-gold meridian ring and tiny simple wooden base. Painted 2D cartoon mobile adventure item icon matching the supplied backpack/coin/key art. Rounded readable silhouette, clean dark brown outlines, warm lantern-light highlight, restrained detail readable at 40 pixels. Centered complete object occupying 85 percent of square, transparent margin, no clipping. Palette teal, emerald, soft cream highlights, amber gold. No people, no Lumi, no label, no text, no badges, no large background circle, no sparkles, no ground shadow and no checkerboard. Genuine transparent background.
